description.value: Ahra is a Korean-Japanese fusion sushi restaurant in Comox that has been a local institution since 2011. The menu blends Japanese sushi traditions with Korean dishes like bibimbap, bulgogi, and mandu guk, using fresh-cut fish and quality ingredients. Cyclists passing through Comox will find a welcoming dine-in spot with a broad menu that caters to varied dietary needs.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 87m; bollard (12 spaces) at 95m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Ahra is a real, operating Korean-Japanese fusion sushi restaurant established in 2011 at 727 Anderton Rd, Comox, BC, with consistent phone (250) 941-8886 across all pages. The menu explicitly labels many items as vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free, and the About page mentions both dine-in and takeout service. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy on the website: front page, photo page, and blog page all show 'V9M 4A9', but the About page shows 'V9M 4G4'. Used V9M 4A9 as it appears on the majority of pages.
OSM record has no address or phone number; these fields were populated from the website only, so contact_confirmed cannot be evaluated for those fields.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a working website, menu, and address. Clearly open and accessible to the public.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page explicitly labels multiple items as Vegetarian, Vegan, and Gluten Free (e.g., Edamame, Plain Sunomono, Steamed Rice, Gomae). Some items also offer a paid Gluten Free option add-on

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Main courses $16–$20.50: donburi, udon, Korean bowls
